description: Proposal that would otherwise pass the verifier (trusted-money shape) is rejected with PIC_TOOL_BINDING_MISMATCH because options.expected_tool='payments_send ' (trailing space) does not match proposal.action.tool='payments_send' under exact string equality. Under v0.9.0a2 the reference verifier no longer applies .strip() in verify_with_context (Phase 2.2 removes MAINT-F1 normalization). Paired with core-allow-002-trusted-money, the only content-level difference across the two vectors is the presence of this options field carrying a whitespace-only delta against the proposal tool.
source: PIC maintainer follow-up MAINT-F1: verify_with_context previously applied .strip() on both sides of the tool comparison, silently normalizing whitespace. Per docs/spec-core.md §7.2 (Representation vs. normalization) exact protocol values must be compared as represented on the wire; v0.9.0a2 removes the normalization in Phase 2.2.
